title: Mujraee Shah ka hoon khuld mein hai ghar mera
body:
Mujraee Shah ka hoon khuld mein hai ghar mera
Muntazar hoorein hain mushtaaq hai Kausar mera
<<DIVIDER>>
Shah kehthay thay layeenou na sathaao mujhko
Maa hai Zehra meri Naana hai Payambar mera
<<DIVIDER>>
Banu kehthi thi kay jungle main darreygaa logou
Kabhi tanhaa nahin soya Ali Asghar mera
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo koyi poochtha kya sin tha tho kehthi Banu
Chey mahiney sey bhi kam tha Ali Asghar mera
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehthi thi rooh-e-Mohammad yeh tamashaaiyoun sey
Bandh aankhein karo kunbaa hai khuley sar mera
<<DIVIDER>>
Shah kehthay thay na soojhi mujhey Abbas ki laash
Leigaye haath pakadd kay Ali Akbar mera
<<DIVIDER>>
Shimr kehtha tha main jab kartha tha Shabbir ko qatl
Kaisi mazloomi sey muh takthey thay Sarwar mera
<<DIVIDER>>
Girya-e-Ahmad-o-Zehra ki sadaa aathi thi
Pakadd leytha tha koyi haath sey khanjar mera
